verdict.rationale: a-Shell is a local iOS Unix-like terminal, and terminals can plausibly ship a built-in AI agent, so this axis applies. The evidence covers shell commands, programming languages, Shortcuts and a local relay server, but nothing about a natural-language AI agent or repository and pull-request insights. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability yields none.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can converse with an AI agent in natural language to get insights into repositories and open pull requests
